profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Raytheon
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with hands-on experience supporting a U.S. Department of Defense contract, developing solutions that enhance mission readiness and align with government operational needs. I bring a strong foundation in computer science and a proven ability to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable applications in sensitive, mission-critical environments.

Proficient in Python, Spring Boot, REST frameworks, JavaScript, Angular, SQL, and HTML/CSS, with experience troubleshooting complex issues, modernizing systems, and implementing solutions that improve efficiency.
